name: 360 RAIN
description: Adaptive irrigation machine that autonomously delivers water, nutrients, manure, byproduct, and other resources of your choice, banded or broadcast, across your entire field, even in irregular shapes with no corners cut. Covers specialty crop applications in addition to row crops.
specs: Autonomous application technology, no fixed pivot point required
Delivers water, nutrients, dairy/hog manure, and digestate
Precision application methods: banded or broadcast
Full field coverage including irregular field shapes (no corners cut)
Adaptive application system adjusts on the go
Suitable for row crops and specialty crops

name: 360 Y-DROP
description: Late-season nitrogen application system that drops nitrogen at the base of the plant during a 30+ day application window from V6 to VT growth stages, targeting the root zone where roughly 80% of root mass concentrates. Boosts yields by an average of 13.8 bushels per acre.
specs: Application window: 30+ days, V6 to VT growth stages
Compatible with 15-inch to 36-inch row spacing
Four-position adjustable arms for precision placement
Variable rate nozzles available for customized application rates
Breakaway brackets with flexible risers for terrain navigation
Curved hoses prevent tangling; integrated shield protects foliage
Targets 75% of plant nitrogen demand occurring after V10
Delivers nitrogen within seven inches of the stalk base
Average yield boost of 13.8 bushels per acre

name: 360 Y-DROP SIDEDRESS
tagline: Replace Coulters for Better Uptake, More Bushels
description: Upgraded nitrogen placement system that converts existing coulter applicator bars, delivering nitrogen inches from the stalk instead of 15 inches away. Extends the application window to V7 and improves nutrient uptake versus standard coulter application.
specs: Adjustable riser length for mid- to late-season nitrogen application
Four-position adjustable arms, compatible with 15-36 inch rows
Breakaway risers protect against uneven terrain
Variable rate nozzles available for precise rate control
Simple U-bolt retrofit for common coulter bar sizes (4x6, 5x7, 6x4, 6x6, 7x5, 7x7)
Compatible with 360 UNDERCOVER for insecticide/fungicide applications
Average yield increase of over 6 bushels vs. coulter systems
Studies show 25% more nitrates in plants with base application

name: 360 TANKS
tagline: Capacity and balance for in-field productivity
description: 700-gallon liquid nitrogen tank system that contours to the tractor for weight balance, capacity, visibility, and accessibility during on-planter nitrogen application. Improves cab visibility and weight distribution while minimizing compaction.
specs: 700-gallon capacity
Low-profile design improves front and side visibility from the cab
Does not add to transport width
Modular support frame for easier shipping and installation
Improved fore/aft weight distribution reduces front axle loading
Minimizes pinch-row compaction
Accessible tractor side panels for servicing
Compatible with select John Deere 8000R series and Case IH tractor models

name: 360 UNDERCOVER
tagline: Target pests and diseases at the source
description: In-canopy application attachment that adds on to the 360 Y-DROP system to deliver crop protection product to the underside of leaves and the base of the plant, targeting diseases and insects that traditional top-of-canopy spray methods miss.
specs: Easy add-on to the 360 Y-DROP system; slides up/down riser for growth-stage positioning
Up to four multi-directional spray nozzles per unit
Customizable spray pattern with 150-degree horizontal spray application
Protective shell design for smooth canopy navigation
Compatible crops: corn, seed corn, soybeans, wheat, cotton, sugar beets, sorghum
Targets white mold, bacterial blights, spider mites, whiteflies, sugarcane aphids, soybean aphids

name: 360 BANDIT
description: The simple, safe solution for banding nitrogen with the planter. Bands liquid nitrogen alongside corn seed during planting, positioning it three inches from the seed and 3/4-inch below the soil surface to optimize early root interception while reducing volatilization and eliminating a separate application trip.
specs: Bands liquid nitrogen on both sides of the seed, 3 inches away
Shallow 3/4-inch placement depth
Spring-loaded poly tube follows coulter slot for precise placement
Mounts to row unit in front of the closing wheel
No impact on gauge wheels or depth settings
Compact design adds minimal transport width
Optional drag chain seals nitrogen and covers seed trench
Compatible with John Deere Max Emerge/7000, Kinze 2000/3000, White 8000/9000, Harvest International Laser Pro 1, Case IH, Great Plains

name: 360 WAVE
tagline: Enhanced seed-trench closing with rapid starter uptake
description: Angled blade planter attachment that improves corn seed emergence by surrounding seeds with moist soil and delivering starter fertilizer strategically. Mounts to the row-unit shank and pivots to follow the seed trench, creating a wave of moist soil that rolls over the seed.
specs: Creates a moist soil wave that rolls over seeds, simplifying closing wheel operation
Self-aligning pivoting blade follows the seed trench through curves, with safety stop
Spring-loaded design navigates obstacles without damage or bent alignment
Liquid tube positions starter fertilizer 3/4 inch right of seed trench, below the seed
Hardened knife edge for extended wear life
Mounts to rear of planter row-unit shank
Compatible with John Deere and Kinze planters

name: 360 GLIDE
description: Reliable, mechanical automatic height control for the 360 Y-DROP system. A sensor rod mounted to the Y-DROP base constantly adjusts position relative to ground level and integrates with existing boom control systems without requiring additional controllers.
specs: Mechanical sensor rod glides over field terrain
Automatically maintains ideal 360 Y-DROP base position
Flexible rod design handles contours, turns, and backing
Three sensors plug into existing control system center module
Rugged breakaway system for obstruction protection
Compatible with John Deere BoomTrac Pro, Hagie applicators, and Rogator applicators (Norac UC5 and UC7)
No additional monitors or elaborate configuration required

name: 360 SOILSCAN
tagline: Measure nitrate levels to maximize nitrogen efficiency
description: Portable soil test system that enables field-based testing of nitrogen availability and soil pH with lab-equivalent accuracy in about five minutes. Combines yield goals, crop growth stage, and soil organic matter data to generate customized nitrogen application recommendations.
specs: Real-time soil nitrate and pH measurement
Five-minute testing turnaround in the field
iPad-based operating platform with wireless upgrade capability
Rugged carrying case designed for field durability
Portable, operates from a truck or ATV
98% certification rate through the Agricultural Laboratory Proficiency Program
Customized nitrogen calculator based on yield goals and crop growth stage

name: 360 CHAINROLL
tagline: Unlock the nutrients trapped in corn residue
description: Precision residue management system that creates seven-inch stalk chains for rapid breakdown and improved nutrient availability. Replaces standard stalk rolls on corn heads, using perforated stalks to accelerate microbial decomposition while allowing row cleaners to remove residue from seed trenches.
specs: Creates seven-inch stalk chains ideal for rapid breakdown and row-cleaner compatibility
Perforated stalks increase surface area for faster microbial activity
Combination of cutting flutes and piercing teeth creates chain-like perforated residue
Reduces seedling blights, wicking, and low ear counts vs. confetti-style chopping
Demonstrated 2.5-bushel yield advantage over standard stalk rolls
Direct replacement for existing stalk rolls
Compatible with John Deere 40/90 and 600 series, Case IH 4000, Geringhoff Northstar heads

name: 360 YIELD SAVER
tagline: Don't let yield fall through the cracks
description: Corn header attachment using poly blocks and intermeshing bristles to reduce crop loss by cushioning ear impact (reducing butt shelling) and capturing kernels. Reduces header loss by up to 85% in side-by-side testing, with 75%+ ROI potential within three years.
specs: Angled bristles designed for maximum kernel capture
Traditional-style gathering chain with replaceable brush blocks
Blocks snap and screw into position for quick replacement
Average brush block life exceeds 150 acres per row
Chain wear life similar to traditional gathering chains
Compatible with John Deere 600/40/90, Case IH 1000-5000, Geringhoff Northstar, Drago Series 1 and 2
Reduces header loss by up to 85% in side-by-side testing
Potential savings of ~$16,000 gross yield on a typical 8-row, 1,200-acre operation (2 bu/ac savings)

name: 360 BULLET
tagline: Full Fracture and Unrestricted Root Access
description: Berm-busting ripper point designed to eliminate undisturbed soil berms that impede root access. Aerodynamically positioned 14-inch wide wings create fault lines that fracture soil across the total profile, improving access to nutrients and water without requiring significantly more horsepower than traditional ripper points.
specs: Eliminates approximately 40% of undisturbed subsoil berms left by standard rippers
14-inch wide design with precision wing angle and pitch
Available in cast chrome (high wear), hardened steel (HD+), and fabricated steel with cast nose cap
Lifts and fractures soil without creating compaction
Minimal increase in fuel consumption or horsepower requirements
Compatible with Case IH 870/875/530/730, John Deere 512/2730, Landoll 2410/2430, Kuhn Krause Dominator, DMI 530/730
